resources.string: Leave it empty to show the provider\'s own id, %1$s.
Tap a model to give it a display name. Pickers show that name.
Models for the hub\'s side jobs, such as naming chats and summarising. A role left alone uses the default profile\'s.
The stored key is wiped. The provider stops answering until a new key is saved.
Any OpenAI-compatible server: a proxy, a local model, a speech server.
Every agent of this profile uses this model unless it is set to another.
Choose a chat model first; the fallbacks are tried after it.
The microphone and voice mode send what you say to this provider.
Reading replies aloud and voice mode speak through this provider.
The model this profile draws and edits images with. It comes from your chat providers; a profile that chooses none uses the default profile\'s.
None of your chat providers offers an image model. Add or refresh one that has one, such as OpenAI with gpt-image or a signed-in ChatGPT subscription.
Hermes\'s image tool and the image skills use this model with its provider\'s key.
Paste the key. Every provider accepts one.
This provider\'s account already has a key saved here; it is used unless you type another.
A key is stored. Leave this empty to keep it, or paste a new one to replace it.
Search, or type a code such as ar-EG
This list is a fallback kept in code, not the provider\'s own: the provider could not be asked (%1$s). Refresh once it can be.
Fallback list, not the provider\'s own
These are the models your %1$s plan offers, as the provider lists them for your account.
This address is loopback, and the hub runs in a container: it would reach the container itself, not your machine. Try %1$s.
Search, or type a model id
No models yet. Refresh the model list first.
Shared: every profile uses it, including profiles made later.
Only %1$s uses it, and its key wins there over a shared provider of the same kind.
Signed in. Its models are being fetched.
The code ran out before it was used.
The provider lists no models of this kind; type a model id in the search field.
The provider answered with an error.
From the provider\'s documentation: it has no voice list to ask.
This provider lists no voices: type the voice id in the search field.
